data.timestamp_semantics: UTC timestamps, group sessions by timestamp date (all bars within US RTH)
data.data_retention: No raw IBKR data committed to public GitHub due to redistribution concerns

common.daily_filter: previous completed session close > EMA50 > EMA150
common.pullback: max prior 26 intraday highs minus min low in prior 8 bars >= 1.0% of max
common.breakout: signal current completed 15m close > max previous 4 bar highs
common.exit: first stop/target intrabar (stop assumed first if both touched), max 8 bars or session EOD, whichever comes first
common.confidence: fixed plausible exploration assumptions; not original trader rules

candidate_rules.M1: M0 + prior 6-bar low <= 1.005 * previous intraday EMA21 and signal close > current EMA21
candidate_rules.M2: M1 + anchor = highest high within 40 bars prior to signal excluding most recent 3 bars, anchored VWAP calculated from anchor through preceding completed bar, prior 6-bar low <= 1.005 * AVWAP and signal close >= AVWAP

evaluation.gross_net_returns: trade-based equal weighted, no portfolio exposure netting
